boundary.en: Source-bound forensic review, not a linguistic lie detector. Language features generate review questions; they do not establish falsity, intent, credibility, criminality, guilt or liability.
boundary.es: Revisión forense anclada a fuentes, no detector lingüístico de mentiras. Los rasgos del lenguaje generan preguntas de revisión; no acreditan falsedad, intención, credibilidad, criminalidad, culpabilidad ni responsabilidad.

architecture: Registro de falsedad / inversión de verdad

agency_lenses.en: Link-analysis across apparently unrelated entities: compare incorporation histories, name changes and business descriptions; test filings against independent reality such as auditor confirmation, registered-office presence, legitimate trading and actual control. Non-cooperation can prevent verification but is not itself proof of the underlying allegation.
agency_lenses.es: Análisis de vínculos entre entidades aparentemente no relacionadas: comparar historiales de constitución, cambios de nombre y descripciones de actividad; contrastar los asientos con realidad independiente —confirmación del auditor, presencia en domicilio social, actividad legítima y control real—. La falta de cooperación puede impedir verificar, pero no prueba por sí sola la alegación.

agency_lenses.en: Thinking approach: pursue reasonable lines of enquiry toward and away from a suspect; keep requests focused, necessary and proportionate; examine linked investigations; consider cumulative effect and digital communications rather than treating disclosure as a box-ticking schedule.
agency_lenses.es: Enfoque razonado: seguir líneas razonables tanto a favor como en contra; mantener solicitudes focalizadas, necesarias y proporcionales; examinar investigaciones vinculadas; valorar el efecto acumulado y las comunicaciones digitales, no tratar la revelación como mero trámite.

agency_lenses.en: Preserve exculpatory and impeachment information, original notes and recordings; memorialise material witness variations; consider the cumulative impact of items; when precise words matter, return to agent notes rather than relying only on a later summary.
agency_lenses.es: Preservar información exculpatoria y de impugnación, notas originales y grabaciones; documentar variaciones materiales del testigo; valorar el efecto acumulado; cuando importan las palabras exactas, volver a las notas del agente y no depender sólo de un resumen posterior.

agency_lenses.en: Fact-establishment must seek evidence for and against the person concerned, objectively and impartially; digital-evidence specialists, analysts and computer-forensic examiners support casework. The transferable rule is bidirectional testing plus a separate source-integrity lane.
agency_lenses.es: La determinación de hechos busca prueba a favor y en contra, objetiva e imparcialmente; especialistas en prueba digital, analistas y examinadores forenses informáticos apoyan los casos. Regla transferible: contraste bidireccional y carril separado de integridad de fuente.

agency_lenses.en: Parallel financial investigation alongside the predicate inquiry; document the money trail — where funds came from, who received them, when, where stored/deposited — and use financial data to identify associations, movements and other leads.
agency_lenses.es: Investigación financiera paralela junto a la investigación principal; documentar el rastro del dinero —origen, receptor, momento, depósito/destino— y usar los datos financieros para identificar asociaciones, movimientos y nuevas líneas.

agency_lenses.institution: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
agency_lenses.en: Start financial investigation early; trace where money came from and where it went; expected-record gaps are contextual leads, not automatic proof.
agency_lenses.es: Iniciar pronto la investigación financiera; rastrear origen y destino; las ausencias de registros esperables son indicios contextuales, no prueba automática.

agency_lenses.en: Centralise and analyse contributed information to identify international links, groups, suspects, trends and patterns; cross-check operational information against databases; combine financial-flow analysis, intelligence exchange, operational coordination and asset tracing.
agency_lenses.es: Centralizar y analizar información aportada para identificar vínculos internacionales, grupos, sospechosos, tendencias y patrones; contrastar información operativa con bases de datos; combinar flujos financieros, inteligencia, coordinación y rastreo de activos.

agency_lenses.en: Chain of custody, hashes, documented acquisition, reliable/repeatable methods, and separation of source integrity from substantive truth.
agency_lenses.es: Cadena de custodia, hashes, adquisición documentada, métodos fiables/repetibles y separación entre integridad de fuente y verdad sustantiva.

agency_lenses.en: Separate document authenticity from semantic truth. Classify counterfeit, forgery, pseudo-document, fraudulently obtained genuine document and genuine-document misuse; use technical references and forensic examination before asking what the document proves.
agency_lenses.es: Separar autenticidad documental de verdad semántica. Clasificar falsificación integral, alteración, pseudodocumento, documento genuino obtenido fraudulentamente y uso indebido de documento genuino; aplicar referencias técnicas y examen forense antes de decidir qué demuestra.

agency_lenses.institution: Federal Rules of Evidence · scope/completeness lens
agency_lenses.en: When a statement or part of it is used, test whether fairness requires contemporaneous completing context. This supports the project distinction between literal accuracy and misleading implication from context stripping; it is not imported as governing Spanish law.
agency_lenses.es: Cuando se usa una declaración o parte de ella, comprobar si la equidad exige contexto complementario contemporáneo. Refuerza la distinción entre literalidad correcta e inferencia engañosa por descontextualización; no se importa como derecho aplicable en España.

agency_lenses.en: ACH explicitly develops reasonable alternative hypotheses and arrays evidence against all of them, emphasizing disconfirming evidence.
agency_lenses.es: ACH desarrolla hipótesis alternativas razonables y contrasta la prueba frente a todas, priorizando la prueba que desconfirma.

agency_lenses.en: Risk-based financial-crime controls are used here as an expected-artefact lens, not a deception detector.
agency_lenses.es: Los controles de delito financiero basados en riesgo se usan aquí como lente de artefactos esperables, no detector de engaño.

agency_lenses.en: Fraud intelligence separates evidence from judgments, assesses source quality and uses alternative hypotheses, network, pattern, comparative and red-team analysis.
agency_lenses.es: La inteligencia antifraude separa prueba de juicios, evalúa calidad de fuente y utiliza hipótesis alternativas, redes, patrones, comparativa y red-team.

agency_lenses.en: Statement-analysis cues are prompts for further probing and corroboration; no single cue establishes lying.
agency_lenses.es: Las señales de análisis de declaraciones sirven para profundizar y corroborar; ninguna señal aislada acredita mentira.

agency_lenses.en: Preserve the full account, clarify systematically, challenge where necessary, close accurately and evaluate against the wider investigation.
agency_lenses.es: Preservar el relato completo, aclarar sistemáticamente, contrastar cuando proceda, cerrar con precisión y evaluar frente a la investigación global.

dynamic_model.en: The public interface reloads methodology, priority queue and R33 aggregate JSON every 60 seconds. Source-change workflows reopen pinned candidates. New agency lenses enter through this source registry; semantic merits still require source/context/contrary-evidence review.
dynamic_model.es: La interfaz recarga metodología, cola prioritaria y JSON agregado de R33 cada 60 segundos. Los flujos de cambio de fuente reabren candidatos anclados. Nuevas lentes de agencias entran por este registro; el fondo sigue exigiendo revisión de fuente, contexto y prueba contraria.

research_refresh.boundary: External institutions supply transferable investigative principles only; this registry does not claim they endorse Por Derecho or use an automated linguistic lie detector.

open_workspace_controls: source → exact words → proposition → actor/capacity → event/knowledge time → source lineage → supporting/contrary evidence → notice/adoption → causation/benefit → open proof → restatement
observe → manifest → compare → classify → traverse dependencies → adversarial review → reconcile → exact-head verify → deploy/live readback → new envelope → recurse
origin → authority → actor → act/omission → document → proceeding → treatment → consequence → later reuse → beneficiary → contradiction → open question → source
AI proposes/retrieves/compares; deterministic controls verify anchors and source change; source/human review promotes merits

scientific_method_stack.name: Analysis of Competing Hypotheses (ACH)
scientific_method_stack.en: Generate reasonable alternative hypotheses and array evidence against all of them, emphasizing disconfirming evidence rather than only support for the preferred account.
scientific_method_stack.es: Generar hipótesis alternativas razonables y contrastar la prueba frente a todas, priorizando la prueba que desconfirma en lugar de acumular sólo apoyo para la hipótesis preferida.
scientific_method_stack.transfer: H1 accurate-as-used · H2 core fact true but overstated · H3 context changes meaning · H4 directly contradicted · H5 insufficient evidence.

scientific_method_stack.name: Strategic Use of Evidence / statement-evidence consistency
scientific_method_stack.en: Use account–evidence inconsistency as a structured investigative cue. The project adapts the consistency concept only; it does not simulate interviews or transfer published detection rates to documents.
scientific_method_stack.es: Usar la inconsistencia relato–prueba como señal investigativa estructurada. El proyecto adapta sólo el concepto de consistencia; no simula entrevistas ni traslada tasas experimentales a documentos.
scientific_method_stack.transfer: Exact proposition → evidence known/available → evidence cited → contrary evidence → consistency state.

scientific_method_stack.name: Verifiability Approach
scientific_method_stack.en: Identify objectively checkable details and whether they were actually checked. Meta-analytic findings support verifiable-detail differences in interview research, but the system does not infer truth from a detail ratio.
scientific_method_stack.es: Identificar detalles objetivamente comprobables y si fueron efectivamente verificados. El metaanálisis encuentra diferencias en detalle verificable en entrevistas, pero el sistema no deduce verdad de una proporción de detalles.
scientific_method_stack.transfer: Date · amount · actor · document · transaction · filing · account → checkable / checked / confirmed / contradicted / unavailable.

scientific_method_stack.name: Wigmore evidence charting
scientific_method_stack.en: Map ultimate propositions, intermediate inferences, evidence, testimony and source-position-to-know so each inferential bridge is visible.
scientific_method_stack.es: Representar proposiciones finales, inferencias intermedias, prueba, testimonio y posición de la fuente para conocer, haciendo visible cada puente inferencial.
scientific_method_stack.transfer: Proposition node ↔ supporting/contrary evidence ↔ source quality/knowledge ↔ intermediate inference ↔ ultimate proposition.

scientific_method_stack.name: Parallel financial investigation
scientific_method_stack.en: Document origins, recipients, timing, storage/destination and beneficial use of funds in parallel with the narrative investigation.
scientific_method_stack.es: Documentar origen, receptores, momento, depósito/destino y uso/beneficiario de fondos en paralelo con la investigación narrativa.
scientific_method_stack.transfer: Source/balance → authority/invoice → debit → recipient credit → onward use/beneficiary.

scientific_method_stack.name: Expected-control evidence
scientific_method_stack.en: Use risk-based systems-and-controls thinking to ask which approval, monitoring, accounting or governance artefacts should exist if an asserted process occurred.
scientific_method_stack.es: Aplicar el enfoque basado en riesgo de sistemas y controles para preguntar qué artefactos de aprobación, seguimiento, contabilidad o gobierno deberían existir si el proceso alegado ocurrió.
scientific_method_stack.transfer: Asserted process → control owner → expected artefact → located / bounded absence / inconsistent. Absence alone is not fraud.

scientific_method_stack.name: Fraud intelligence analysis
scientific_method_stack.en: Separate evidence from assumptions/judgments, assess source quality, consider alternatives and use pattern, network, comparative-case and red-team products.
scientific_method_stack.es: Separar prueba de supuestos/juicios, evaluar calidad de fuente, considerar alternativas y usar patrones, redes, casos comparativos y red-team.
scientific_method_stack.transfer: Every network edge carries source quality, capacity/date and independence; patterns generate hypotheses, not collective liability.

scientific_method_stack.name: PEACE account integrity
scientific_method_stack.en: Preserve the full account before clarification/challenge, systematically probe gaps, close accurately and evaluate against the wider investigation.
scientific_method_stack.es: Preservar el relato completo antes de aclarar/contrastar, explorar sistemáticamente vacíos, cerrar con precisión y evaluar frente al resto de la investigación.
scientific_method_stack.transfer: Original account first; document-review clarification/challenge only. The tool does not interview people.

scientific_method_stack.name: FBI-hosted statement-analysis probe cues
scientific_method_stack.en: Use equivocation, tense/noun changes, editing/minimising language, imbalance and verbal-context inconsistency only to identify areas for further probing. No single cue establishes lying.
scientific_method_stack.es: Usar equívocos, cambios de tiempo/nombre, lenguaje de edición/minimización, desequilibrio e inconsistencia verbal-contextual sólo para localizar áreas a comprobar. Ninguna señal aislada acredita mentira.
scientific_method_stack.transfer: Linguistic cue → review question → source/context comparison; never cue → lie finding.

scientific_method_stack.name: NIST validation firewall
scientific_method_stack.en: Quantitative forensic methods need documented validation data and performance characterisation appropriate to the conditions of use before numeric output is treated as evidential weight.
scientific_method_stack.es: Los métodos forenses cuantitativos necesitan datos de validación documentados y caracterización de rendimiento apropiada al uso antes de tratar su resultado numérico como peso probatorio.
scientific_method_stack.transfer: No truth probability, credibility percentage or error-rate claim without a validated method and relevant reference data.

scientific_method_stack.name: ENFSI competing-proposition discipline
scientific_method_stack.en: Evaluate findings against competing propositions with balance, logic, robustness and transparency. No likelihood ratio is assigned here because no validated case-relevant probability model/reference data exist.
scientific_method_stack.es: Evaluar hallazgos frente a proposiciones competidoras con equilibrio, lógica, robustez y transparencia. Aquí no se asigna razón de verosimilitud porque no existe modelo probabilístico/datos de referencia validados para el caso.
scientific_method_stack.transfer: Competing propositions yes; numeric LR/probability no unless future validation supports it.

promotion_rules.directly_contradicted: Exact proposition scope must be matched to inspected contrary source(s); a broad contrary theme is insufficient.
promotion_rules.knowingly_false: Requires a supported false/misleading state plus separate actor-specific evidence that the contradicting or omitted material was known at the relevant time.
promotion_rules.deliberate_misleading_use: Requires separate purpose/intent evidence beyond falsity, omission or notice.
promotion_rules.legal_consequence: Never inherited automatically from a falsehood or misleading-use finding.

falsehood_register_policy.boundary: False proposition, misleading inference, knowledge, intent, reliance and legal liability are separate evidential questions.

mandatory_intake_trigger.scope: Every filing, pleading, opposition, submission, annex, evidential package or material representation originating outside the Por Derecho / Gil Marer / AWESWELL LIMITED side from a party or actor adverse or materially adverse in the relevant matter.

high_threshold_labels.rule: Never promote from adverse origin, omission, selectivity, rhetoric or contradiction candidate alone. Require source-complete actor-specific support; where knowledge or intent is asserted, source it separately for the relevant time.

mandatory_intake_trigger.institutional_output_boundary: An unfavourable court, prosecutor or institutional output is not automatically an adverse-party filing. It may receive the same fidelity/context/provenance review in a separate institutional-output lane without inferring adverse alignment from outcome.
